entries.en: to answer, to reply
to answer; to assent, to consent
entries.notes: M 栏音写两音节多于汉字「應」一字，当对应常语「答应」，据音写推断。

entries.zh: 相叫应：一呼一应，闻呼即应答
entries.en: to answer a call; to respond when one is called

entries.zh: 散漫失礼地应答（首字残缺，仅「松」可辨）
entries.en: to answer rudely or carelessly (first Chinese character damaged)
entries.notes: H 栏首字残缺存「松」，据西语 desabridamente（无礼、散漫）与 M 栏音写拟定释义。

entries.zh: 回报上命；对上级差遣或来使的回禀答复
entries.en: to answer the embassy or order of a superior; to send back a report in reply
to look after, to attend to; to answer for someone
entries.notes: 西语词句残缺（en consejo del santoño 义不明），释义依汉字「照應」与 M 栏。

entries.en: damaged entry; meaning undetermined
entries.notes: 西语 arma [残] palabras 残缺，汉字「迎二年」与词头难以对应，M 栏三音节未能安字。

entries.en: to answer a letter; to write a reply

entries.zh: 送信去；寄出回信（批＝书信）
entries.en: to send off a (reply) letter

entries.zh: 允诺；应承，答允（答说是并予承诺）
entries.en: to answer yes; to consent, to promise
entries.notes: 首字[疑:元/允]，取「允」以合「允諾」常语及 R 栏 prometer（承诺）之佐证。

entries.en: to answer yes; to assent

entries.zh: 应卯；点名应到，闻呼即应
entries.en: to answer at roll call; to answer when called on the list
entries.notes: 次字[疑:卯/印]，取「卯」以合 M 栏音写与西语 llaman en la lista（名单点名）之语境。

entries.en: to give back, to return; to restore, to repay
entries.notes: 西语附词 gayar 拼写不明（或为稿本误读），不影响「还」之释义。

entries.zh: 洗门风：旧俗中被人指涉不贞者设宴燃炮、当众涤除污名以恢复名誉
entries.en: to wash the door lintel: Hokkien custom of publicly clearing a family's defamed honor; to restore one's honor

entries.zh: 回护；袒护遮护，为保全名誉而辩护
entries.en: to shield, to defend; to vindicate someone's honor
damaged entry; meaning undetermined
entries.notes: 汉字回[疑:屎/尿]肚后接残损，M 栏八音节仅前半可安字，R 栏 robar（抢夺）疑属下条词头，语义无从定夺。

entries.en: to live; to come back to life, to be resurrected
to live again, to come back to life
entries.notes: M 栏四音节多于汉字二声，后两音节未能安字，释义取「再活」。

entries.en: to come back to life, to rise up

entries.zh: 再活起来；死而复生（多用于天主教复活语境）
entries.en: to come back to life again; to rise from the dead
